title: Inverse-Root Support and Fourier Fusion for Polynomial Exponential Periods: All-Degree Low-Rank Completion
description: Public unrefereed theorem candidate, relative to named primitive-polynomial-monodromy and finite-projective-group classification inputs. This additive successor proves an all-degree classification of complex polynomial phases with fixed seed dx and cyclic rank at most three, together with all proper rank-preserving outer extensions. It preserves and corrects the earlier candidate: a false uniform Kummer-kernel assertion is replaced by a coefficient-stratified theorem and exceptional-stratum descent. Lean and separate CAS implementations check scoped consequences; no external reproduction, complete formalisation, peer review, or priority certification is claimed.
